info.title: dytools-deploy - config-driven .NET deployment across one or more servers.
info.description: A config-driven .NET tool for deploying .NET applications across one or more servers. Reads a single deploy-config.json, diffs changed files against the project dependency graph to decide what needs deploying, runs unit-test gates and prerequisite installs, then plans and applies a staged rollout - IIS app pools, folder copies, or Velopack packages - with commit-message directives, peer soak delays, rollback, and a full run report.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Deploy (the primary; this is what CI runs)

options.name: --changed
options.description: Pipe-separated changed files. Decides what needs deploying.

options.name: --force-all
options.description: Deploy everything, ignoring the changed-file diff.

options.name: --wait
options.description: Override the rollout soak delay. 0 = peers apply immediately.

options.name: --server
options.description: Pin which servers[] entry this box is.
